events.title: 🎉 Broken Shell Releases in Janurary 2027! 🎉
events.summary: Hi everyone,We are excited to announce that Broken Shell is officially scheduled to release in Janurary 14, 2027!This is a special moment for our team, and we are incredibly grateful to celebrate it with all of you. Your support, encouragement, and feedback throughout development have helped make this project a reality.Broken Shell has been a journey of passion, creativity, and dedication. We've worked hard to create a unique experience, and we can't wait for you to explore the world we've built

events.title: Broken Shell Featured in Trailer Tuesday Show
